changes.evidence: The Hobgoblin two-parter (Marvel DB S1E11-12, the record's episode 12): Norman Osborn hires him and then fires him. He switches to work for the Kingpin, betrays him over pay and goes back to Osborn. He then drives Fisk out, declares himself the new Kingpin of Crime and is chased off when Fisk takes his empire back. He works alone afterwards (the Landon blackmail, episode 18). In Goblin War! (S3E13, the record's episode 40) the Kingpin accepts his offer of a partnership, and he is then unmasked and arrested. Marvel DB lists his affiliations as 'Formerly: Oscorp, Kingpin'. The single 'Fisk's Empire (from the start)' stage misses the Oscorp start, the split and the return. If the owner does not count a hired assassin as Oscorp, use [Fisk's Empire, Independent, Fisk's Empire].

The record's last stage is the Insidious Six, which the Kingpin reunited in Six Forgotten Warriors (the record's episode 57). The arc ends in S5E6 'The Price of Heroism': the Chameleon betrays the Six to the Red Skull, the Doomsday complex collapses with the Kingpin's plans, and the rest of the Six disband because there is no profit in it (Marvel DB team page: Status Defunct, Last appearance S5E6). His own crime empire carries on, so it should be his final stage. Doctor Octopus's record already ends Independent after this disbanding.

owner_calls.question: In 'To Catch a Spider' (the record's episode 19), Dr. Noah Boddy breaks Electro, the Green Goblin and the Vulture out of prison so they can take revenge on Spider-Man together. Does this one-episode team-up with no name in the show count as joining a group? The same answer applies to T:sv-green-goblin-1967 and T:sv-vulture-1967. Marvel Database names the team 'Spider-Catchers', but only from the 2015 comic Spider-Verse Team-Up #2, not from the show.
options: No group: keep groups empty for all three (current)
Add a 'Spider-Catchers' (or 'Noah Boddy's gang') stage at Spider-Man (1967) for Electro, the Green Goblin and the Vulture
owner_calls.evidence: Wikipedia episode list, 19a 'To Catch a Spider': 'Dr Noah Boddy springs Electro, the Green Goblin, and the Vulture from prison so that they can all get revenge on Spider-Man... the police arrest all of them.'

owner_calls.question: On Battleworld in Secret Wars, Doctor Octopus loses his realm to Doom and then joins forces with the Red Skull and Alistair Smythe, before Doom sends him home without his memory. Should this alliance be a stage before his final Independent?
options: Keep as is: final stage Independent (current)
Add a Red Skull alliance stage at Spider-Man (1994) before the final Independent
owner_calls.evidence: Marvel DB S5E10 'The Gauntlet of the Red Skull': 'Doctor Octopus and Alistair Smythe join forces with the Red Skull.' Character page: 'Octavius went to work for Red Skull and Alistair Smythe. When Doom stole the Beyonder's powers, he sent Ock and the other villains back to Earth and erased their memories.'
